newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: State Bank brings down Mauritius bourse index.
newsitem.headline: State Bank brings down Mauritius bourse index.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index Semdex lost 2.57 points to 380.95 on Monday reflecting falling shares in State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) and a continuing subdued market sentiment, brokers said.
Turnover was posted at 4.73 million rupees on 166,234 shares from 6.44 million rupees on 339,358 shares on Friday.
Brokers said foreign investors were not very active on the market but would probably return after 1997/98 budget speech expected in around two weeks.
SBM fell 60 cents to 11.40 on 63,950 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank was stable at 89.00 rupees on 21,468 shares.
"SBM shares have been very volatile during the last 10 trading sessions," a broker said.

In the hotel sector, Sun Resorts lost 40 cents to 49.50 rupees but was not traded. Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged to 47.20 rupees and was also not traded. New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 36.20 rupees on 7,685 shares.
Rogers was 1.50 higher at 96.50 rupees on 5,038 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd remained at 15.60 rupees on 1,200 shares.
Sugar-based Mon Tresor Mon Desert rose 60 cents to 39.40 rupees on 150 shares, Mount lost 30 cents to 23 rupees on 2,000 shares and Harel Freres was stable at 57 on 2,000 shares.

Industry companies Gamma Civic eased 20 cents to 18.50 rupees on 5,100 shares, Mauritius Oil Refineries gained 30 cents to 11.50 rupees on 30,564 shares and United Basalt Products (UBP) climbed 50 cents to 34 rupees on 5,750 shares.

In the investment sector, Fincorp was a rupee higher at 70 rupees on 1,160 shares, Promotion And Development (PAD) lost 20 cents to 14.80 rupees on 1,000 shares and Policy gained five cents to 4.25 rupees on 8,357 shares. National carrier Air Mauritius fell 90 cents to 40.50 rupees on 750 shares.
